name: ml-model-evaluation
description: Use when the user asks about choosing evaluation metrics, ROC-AUC vs PR-AUC, calibration, cross-validation strategy (time series, grouped), bias-variance diagnosis, learning curves or comparing two models statistically. Produces metric selection, CV design and significance testing. Not for explanations (use ml-model-interpretability) or tuning (use ml-hyperparameter-tuning).
